# The arrival of a_usd_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt with a
# third split, 0.00 USD on the US dollar bank with no value stated, for
# `--strategy update`.
#
# A split added on the bank makes every split on it read again, from what the
# bank held without the arrival: 0.00 USD. The fee of 0.72 USD dated the same
# day draws on the arrival's cost basis, so it came after the arrival and is
# not counted in what the bank held before it. So the arrival still brings in
# its 2,720.00, the cost basis is what it was, and the edit goes through.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
